The ideal candidate will have strong experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, Kubernetes, Cloud Security, Infrastructure Automation, and AI workload operations, with the ability to support production AI environments and implement robust governance, monitoring, and security controls.

Experience managing highly available and secure enterprise platforms.
Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Bicep, ARM, or equivalent)
Monitoring & Observability (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Azure Monitor, etc.)

AI Platform Operations or MLOps Experience

GPU-based AI infrastructure and model serving

d: O’fuq Programme – International Wealth & Premier Banking (Qatari Nationals Only)
Some careers open more doors than others.

If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

We are currently seeking ambitious Qatari Nationals to join to join our three-year O’fuq Program (GCB 7) working alongside colleagues to define, manage and achieve business targets across our global network.

HSBC aims to be the international bank of choice for affluent customers, supporting their domestic and international banking, and holistic wealth management needs. We help customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to support individuals, families, business owners, investors and entrepreneurs around the world.
O’fuq Program is 30 months to 3-year rotational program offering ‘on the job’ training experience in a fast-paced dynamic environment for new and recent graduates.
The program focuses on providing participants with professional development opportunities and real time tailored personal growth opportunities.
Four 9 months rotation across key divisions.

HSBC O’fuq careers provide specialist development in specific areas of the Bank’s Qatar operations, and whichever route you take, you’ll be sure to get your career off to a great start. We will work with you to understand your areas of interest and your aspirations and offer placement opportunities.

Developing Leaders: Our HSBC O’fuq program are all underpinned by the same desire; to maximize your chances of becoming a highly effective leader in a market-leading global organization. To help realize this goal, our graduate scheme provides a range of leadership development that run parallel to the business-specific training you’ll receive. We’re very confident you’ll be fully supported along the way, and here’s why:

Mentoring Scheme: You’ll be assigned a senior mentor within the business. They’ll have real insight into how best to manage your career, and they’ll be available for advice and guidance at the times you need them most.

Communication, Influencing and Business Partnering: This program provides you the ability to work effectively across the organization and will be critical to your future success. This program will challenge your thinking and really develop your interpersonal style and skills.

Teamwork: Maximizing team performance is a skill we’ll be keen to help you develop. Short courses and individual coaching will seek to help you develop your understanding of team dynamics and your impact on others.
Job Rotations: Four six-month placements will provide you with specialist knowledge of our operations.
q: Bachelor’s degree in relevant area with min GPA 2.0/4.0.
Knowledge of international business and various industry sectors.
Exposure to and appreciation of working in a global environment.
Strong ‘team’ skills promoting an environment of co-operation and trust, overcoming resistance where encountered.
Good prioritizing, organizational and time management abilities.
Good verbal and written communications skills.
Only Qatari Nationals will be considered.
You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

Alfanar is a Saudi company with an international presence, primarily engaged in the manufacturing and trading of a wide variety of low, medium, and high voltage electrical products, in addition to its portfolio of conventional and renewable energy solutions, oil and gas, water treatment, infrastructure, technical services, and digital solutions.

The hub of alfanar’s manufacturing operations is Medinet alfanar Alsinaiya, a 700,000 square-meter complex located in Riyadh. The complex houses an array of ultra-modern manufacturing facilities and laboratories equipped with state-of-the-art technologies and staffed with highly skilled professionals.

alfanar derives its success from its commitment to providing the highest quality standards to its customers, and the continuous development of its human capital, who alfanar considers its most valuable asset. With this in mind, alfanar promotes a proactive work environment where its employees are always valued, nurtured, and empowered to fuel their pride in being part of alfanar.
